name: Sami
description: Sami is a young human freelance captain of the Seriema, who goes by they and spends the story searching for their lost cat Mirri.

description_citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

summary.text: Sami is a young human freelance captain of the Seriema, who goes by they and spends the story searching for their lost cat Mirri.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

bio.text: Mirri weftwalked away from Sami and vanished, and Sami took a job for the Metalman looting Sigma's Reach.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

bio.text: At the colony Sami found empty slipsuits and a stone in the inspection pool that knocked against them as they fell into it.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 2" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jun 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 2" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jun 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 2" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jun 2025.

bio.text: Sami rescued the crashed Hopelight pilot Alpharael, later escaped Taro-duend using the Guns of Kavaron, and took Alpharael and Haliya in under mallowmass.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

bio.text: Sami told Tezzeret, who preferred that name to the Metalman, that the stone changes the past, and then devised a plan to steal a warp ferry and ask for help.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

bio.text: Sami revealed having been kitchen help on the Wurm Speaker and told Mantis the whole story of the artifact.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

bio.text: At Infinite Guideline Sami and Tannuk electrocuted an eld, Sami found Mirri in a stasis cask, and Sami forced a game of chicken that opened the eternity column.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

bio.text: The Endstone steered the Seriema toward the Wurmwall, where the ship's engine died and a visitor told Sami the serpent needs a hero.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

status.text: As of the latest story Sami is alive and captain of the Seriema, reunited with Mirri but having lost most of their crew apart from first mate Tannuk, and carried toward the Wurmwall.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

"Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Pursued by Vondam, Alpharael is shot down in the debris field of Kavaron and rescued by Sami and Tannuk.
timeline.quote: Alpharael was shot down and crashed in the debris field of Kavaron

citation.text: "Alpharael", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haliya tries to force Alpharael to alter the past; Vondam slaughters the Kav citizens, convincing Haliya the Summists were wrong, and the crew escapes.
timeline.quote: Vondam refused to hurt Haliya and opened fire on the Kav citizens instead, slaughtering them all.

citation.text: "Alpharael", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret meets the crew and a dice roll sends them to Infinite Guideline Station.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret found that it wanted them to go to Infinite Guideline Station

citation.text: "Alpharael", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mirri weftwalks away from Sami and vanishes, and Sami is determined to find her.
timeline.quote: Mirri weftwalked—and vanished.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami and Tannuk aboard the Seriema perform main engine cutoff after their flight plan is rejected by Pinnacle.
timeline.quote: The flight computer stills the main engine.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami decides to land at the deserted Sigma's Reach and take it for all it's worth, to save it from abandonment.
timeline.quote: they are going to land at the deserted colony and take it for all it's worth.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Seriema braking through Sigma's atmosphere detects a Sunstar palestar warship, which flies off after something else.
timeline.quote: The palestar's taking off toward the other side of Sigma, chasing something else.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami suspects the Metalman's request is a job rather than a favor, and he sent them to find an artifact.
timeline.quote: No. He said artifact .

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Seriema approaches Sigma's Reach from the east at sunset of Sothera's black hole.
timeline.quote: Sothera is now a supervoid, a black hole sun.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami and Tannuk find Sigma's Reach brightly lit with a welcome sign even though the Metalman said it was empty.
timeline.quote: WELCOME TO SIGMA'S REACH—POPULATION 13,879 PLUS FRIENDS AND FAMILY

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Scans show the colony hot, with elevated carbon dioxide and a fission plant but no living thing.
timeline.quote: No. Not one living thing.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Despite his awful feeling, Tannuk does not ask Sami to abort, and they begin to land.
timeline.quote: Let's take a look. And then decide how much we can steal.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami and Tan land at Sigma's Reach and find a colony still in its wrap but with lights on and a dinner smell.
timeline.quote: Someone got here before us.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 2" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami spies into a house and finds a freshly served dinner and a house that welcomes them, though the Choprights never arrived.
timeline.quote: The Choprights aren't here to receive guests right now.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 2" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami finds hundreds of warm, used empty slipsuits strewn on the avenue.
timeline.quote: There are … slipsuits. Empty slipsuits. Everywhere.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 2" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami suspects the Metalman sent them to limit his losses, but Tan insists on staying with Sami and reports a cat-like sound near the mining sheds.
timeline.quote: Captain, I think it's a cat.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 2" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Tan questions the colony viy about evidence of people and it gives mechanical excuses for each sign.
timeline.quote: They were not. There are no people here.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 2" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami runs toward the mining face and sees glazed impressions of bodies in the clay, which the viy dismisses as lightning fulgurites.
timeline.quote: Baked into the clay. Glazed impressions of bodies, twisting in anguish.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 2" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami enters a processing shed and falls into the QA cyst where a stone moves in the inspection pool.
timeline.quote: "QUALITY ASSURANCE CYST ZERO-ONE."

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 2" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami tries to catch the stone in a hotcell as it whispers choosing one.
timeline.quote: bounces happily toward the hotcell.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 2" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: A burnt Tannuk carrying a melted suit of armor appears, and in the struggle Sami's gauntlet hits the cask and the stone knocks against Sami, who falls into the pool.
timeline.quote: falling into their own dead and staring eyes

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 2" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami wakes aboard the Seriema under fusion thrust with fuzzy memory, and Tan says Sami fell ill and he loaded the cask aboard.
timeline.quote: I found you in the QA cyst attached to one of the mining sheds.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 2" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Tan notes moxite's value has been sliding everywhere in Sothera though the mine never opened, and they head for Kavaron.
timeline.quote: Like someone opened a new moxite mine here.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 2" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Seriema narrowly avoids a tumbling kilometer-wide piece of a shattered planet.
timeline.quote: A thousand-gigaton piece of a shattered planet, seven kilometers across and tumbling, flashes past the Seriema at nine kilometers per second.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Seriema flies through the Mordraine Ring toward Kavaron That Is to find a stasis cask for their prize.
timeline.quote: The Seriema plunges stern first through the Mordraine Ring, toward Kavaron That Is and a stasis cask to hold their prize.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: A Kavaron Memorial Navy controller warns the Seriema it is off track.
timeline.quote: You are off track.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The controller writes them off as wake criminals, leaving them beyond help.
timeline.quote: Marking you beyond help. Worst of luck, robbers. Out.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Tan notices a Sunstar Hopelight warmaker following them down.
timeline.quote: Just so you know, there's a fighter following us.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami blows up a rock with a beacon to clear a path while Tan flies through the debris.
timeline.quote: I'm gonna blow that chunk into its buddy. You ready?

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Tan detects a Kavaron Memorial Navy team in the area, probably heading for the same cache.
timeline.quote: No. There's someone else down there.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Hopelight fires its fusion engine in the atmosphere, blowtorches Tan's cache site and crashes into the rock.
timeline.quote: The Hopelight descends on its plume of disaster, blowtorches the cache site with its suicidal engine burn, and splatters into the rock.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami lands the Seriema on a basalt plain, and they set out for the cache.
timeline.quote: Sami sets the Seriema down on a plain of flood basalt

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami decides to investigate the crashed Hopelight despite Tan's fear of the KMN.
timeline.quote: "We should take a look," Sami settles on.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami promises Tan they will not let the Kav hurt him.
timeline.quote: I won't let them hurt you. I promise.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami learns the wounded Hopelight pilot is a Monoist who has stolen the Free Company's fighter.
timeline.quote: That's a Monoist name. In a Sunstar Free Company fighter.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami introduces themself to Alpharael and promises to get him out alive.
timeline.quote: I'm Captain Sami, and my friend is Tannuk.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Armed Kav of the Memorial Navy surround the crash site.
timeline.quote: The crater rim is lined with armed Kav.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: A narrator reveals that Sami's rescue attempt was a deliberate drastic intervention against Pinnacle.
timeline.quote: Pinnacle must be disrupted.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami removes their helmet and invents a cover story as an agent of the Monastery of the True Faith.
timeline.quote: We serve the Monastery of the True Faith at Susur Secundi, which you call Anuki.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The subedar offers to escort them to Taro-duend if they prove they are Monoists.
timeline.quote: Prove you're with the Monoists, and we will escort you to the strike town at Taro-duend.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami gambles that the Metalman's artifact on the Seriema can pass for a damaged singularity bead.
timeline.quote: "The proof is in the cache," Sami says, gambling wildly.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The subedar laughs and agrees to fetch a stasis cask and take them all to Taro-duend.
timeline.quote: We'll get you a stasis cask for your singularity and take you all to Taro-duend.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The subedar makes Tannuk call an old coin flip; the coin lands point facing her.
timeline.quote: More chance than you gave your victims, Tannuk.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Kav load the stasis cask into the Seriema's cargo bay next to the hotcell holding the Metalman's artifact.
timeline.quote: The Kav haul the stasis cask up into the cargo bay and park it next to the hotcell containing the weird rock from Sigma.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: A Kav opens the hotcell and sees the artifact, which looks like a spitball.
timeline.quote: The Metalman's artifact lies there, in the dark, in a wasp's nest of congealed shear starch.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The subedar orders her troops to kill Sami's group.
timeline.quote: Enough. Kill them.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami broadcasts a mayday to Taro-duend reporting twenty-four Kav soldiers with lethal radiation trauma.
timeline.quote: Twenty-four KMN aboard with lethal radiation trauma.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The dying Kav staggered into the Seriema's cargo bay and begged for rescue.
timeline.quote: They had just enough strength left to stagger into the Seriema 's cargo bay and beg for rescue.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami denies to Taro-duend that the Seriema fired a fusion drive.
timeline.quote: It wasn't us.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Recalling earlier events, Sami notes that Alpharael had a fit when put in the stasis cask with the stone.
timeline.quote: when Sami put the bleeding Monoist in the stasis cask with the rock, the Monoist had a fit.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami discovers a perfect hole in Alpharael's right palm under the medical sleeve.
timeline.quote: they discovered a mystery: a perfect hole in his right palm.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Tannuk argues that Alpharael's fusion burn was a disaster, not evil, and cannot be punished.
timeline.quote: You can't avenge a disaster. You can't punish a disaster.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami lands in a slag pool at Taro-duend and the pool is drained as Kav rescue crews rush the ship.
timeline.quote: The moment that Sami cuts thrust, someone opens the sluicegate and drains the slag pool.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami tells the coach a story of rescuing the soldiers while the coach repeats Sami's words, and offers engine telemetry as proof of innocence.
timeline.quote: I'm going to tell the truth.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The postilion unwittingly reveals that Kav believe Sigma's Reach has miners and exports moxite.
timeline.quote: They'd want Kav labor, wouldn't they?

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami and Tannuk puzzle that the Sigma mine never opened yet moxite prices fell.
timeline.quote: That mine never opened.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Tannuk volunteers to fetch fuel while Sami investigates Sigma's Reach.
timeline.quote: So, Tan goes out to buy fuel and reaction mass for the Seriema .

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami goes to ask the political postilion what he knows about Sigma's Reach.
timeline.quote: And Sami, mouse-small in the crowds of Kav, goes to find the political postilion and ask him what he knows about Sigma's Reach.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The postilion asks Sami where their addled man Gorodoro is.
timeline.quote: Where is your addled man? Gorodoro?

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The postilion sees through Sami's act and asks if they are a liar.
timeline.quote: Are you a liar, Captain Sami?

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The postilion says he saw the hotcell cask stamped for Sigma's Reach.
timeline.quote: I saw the hotcell cask. It had a destination stamp, Sigma's Reach.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The postilion reveals that cheap moxite from Sigma's Reach ruined his moxite futures.
timeline.quote: And instead it plummeted! Undercut by cheap, clean moxite from Sigma's Reach!

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami tells the postilion that Sigma's Reach never opened, shocking him.
timeline.quote: Sigma's Reach never opened.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami asks about Mirri, showing a picture.
timeline.quote: Sami produces a picture of Mirri.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: A Sunstar Free Company ship arrives at Taro-duend demanding the escaped spies.
timeline.quote: It's the Sunstar Free Company. They're demanding we turn over the escaped spies we're harboring.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The postilion refuses to hand over Sami and decides to obstruct justice.
timeline.quote: This is a harbor for scum!

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael finds Sami's note saying they are out for fuel and he is locked in.
timeline.quote: Gone out for fuel—back soon.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tannuk hides Sami under his poncho as they move through the chaos.
timeline.quote: You could not ask for a better first mate or a worse fugitive than Tannuk.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami concludes the stone is making them lucky enough to avoid detection.
timeline.quote: It's the rock, Tannuk. The rock is lucky.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A Free Company officer fires a microwave weapon on the crowd.
timeline.quote: One of the Free Company officers fires up a microwave weapon.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami speculates that a similar past rewrite emptied Sigma's Reach of its people.
timeline.quote: Maybe there were people there, before we showed up.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami refuses to give up the stone because the Metalman is their hope of finding Mirri.
timeline.quote: then he wouldn't fix our ship. And then who'd look for Mirri?

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: As a human and a Kav, apparently Sami and Tannuk, reach the Seriema's ramp, Haliya shoots the human through the heart.
timeline.quote: She lases the human through the heart.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Seriema's cargo ramp has been lowered by someone who found the ship, and Sami runs for it.
timeline.quote: Someone has found the Seriema , and the prow cargo ramp is down, opening the long jut of the number-one cargo bay to boarding.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami finds Alpharael huddled at the feet of the frozen Sunstar armor, holding the stone and the injector.
timeline.quote: a suit of golden armor standing, frozen, over Alpharael, who is huddled wretchedly around its ankles

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael says the armored woman killed Sami, though she didn't.
timeline.quote: "She killed you," Alpharael says.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami resolves to try escaping despite near-zero odds.
timeline.quote: Our chances of flying out of here with a palestar and Hopelights overhead are zero.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tannuk reveals he has pulled the subedar armor's Guns codes.
timeline.quote: And the encryption's no match for Pinnacle breakers. I pulled them already.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami lifts the Seriema out of the cave and over the slag field.
timeline.quote: Sami gooses the ship up on a pulse of thrust.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya appears in the cockpit and offers herself as a hostage.
timeline.quote: "Looking for a hostage?" Haliya says.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya demands the ship land and puts herself on the distress frequency so Vondam will hear.
timeline.quote: Land this ship. Put me on one-forty-two.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami refuses Alpharael's offer to use the stone to undo the atrocity.
timeline.quote: It didn't work on Sigma, and it won't work here.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami takes Vondam's silence as permission to escape.
timeline.quote: May I take this as your permission to make my escape?

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Seriema lunges up into space.
timeline.quote: The Seriema lunges up into space.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Guns' boost beams push the Seriema's mirrored sail out across the Mordraine Ring into interplanetary space.
timeline.quote: And when their beams converge on the Seriema 's sail, carefully diffused to avoid melting right through it, they push the little ship.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami declares Alpharael and Haliya guests under mallowmass to stop them fighting.
timeline.quote: Captain Sami declares that all their new passengers are guests under the protection of mallowmass.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami learns that the Dawnsire carries a weapon to turn Sothera back into a sun.
timeline.quote: Wait. Undo sekhar? Are you talking about turning Sothera back into a real sun?

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya and Alpharael explain to Sami how they came to Kavaron.
timeline.quote: Together the two of them explain to Captain Sami how they came to Kavaron.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya decides the object must be destroyed, and Sami objects.
timeline.quote: We need to destroy the object. It poisons everything.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami reveals they are looking for their lost cat Mirri.
timeline.quote: I look for my cat.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami explains that Mirri weftwalked on Uthros and vanished.
timeline.quote: She weftwalked.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya offers to help look for the cat.
timeline.quote: I'll help you look for the cat,

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami insists the stone will be given to the Metalman rather than destroyed.
timeline.quote: We're giving it to the Metalman.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami tells them the Metalman is a wizard.
timeline.quote: I told you. He's a wizard .

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami announces over the intercom that the Metalman has arrived and prefers the name Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: The Metalman's here. Come out and present yourselves, or he'll present you.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret enters the Seriema from his black engineless ship.
timeline.quote: He pushes into the Seriema with the calm of a prybar.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret greets Sami as the protector of strays and asks for his prize.
timeline.quote: Sami, the generous. Sami, the charitable. Sami, the protector of strays.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami tells Tezzeret the stone changes the past, as with the vanished miners of Sigma.
timeline.quote: Change the past to suit its purposes.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret says he will see the stone now.
timeline.quote: You're keeping it in your hold. I'll see it now.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret drops a crystal over a map of Sothera and it rolls to a libratory point near Uthros.
timeline.quote: He pinches it between two of his claw-fingers, lifts it above the map, and lets go.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A Free Company search radar sweeps toward the drifting Seriema.
timeline.quote: Search radar howls across the dark.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tannuk admits he is lying to Sami to protect them, but it is too late.
timeline.quote: "It's that kind of lie," Tannuk says.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami reveals their real plan is to ask Pinnacle, the Free Company and the Monoists for help.
timeline.quote: Sami's plan is to ask for help.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami promises to return for Mirri.
timeline.quote: I won't be leaving Mirri behind. I'll come back for her.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Illvoi extend a superfluid helium bubble around the Seriema.
timeline.quote: they snug their ship up close and extend their helium bubble around Sami's ship.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mm'menon introduces themself and asks to come aboard.
timeline.quote: I am Mm'menon. May I come aboard your home?

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret admits he is saving his own ship in case he must abandon the others.
timeline.quote: You're saving it in case you need to abandon the rest of us to die.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami threatens to blow up the ship rather than let Tezzeret harm Haliya, invoking mallowmass.
timeline.quote: "I will detonate this ship if I have to," Sami says.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells Sami nothing is sacred, only useful, and challenges Sami to prove guest right is useful.
timeline.quote: Nothing's sacred. Only useful.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami lays out a plan for Haliya and Alpharael to steal a warp ferry from Infinite Guideline's docking arms.
timeline.quote: Haliya and Alpharael will use armor to leap from the Seriema to one of the harbormaster modules at the end of Infinite Guideline's docking arms.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A narrator describes alternate branches for where the crystal might point, rejects each, and says to go back and choose better.
timeline.quote: Go back and make a better choice.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael identifies a mass leech called a myzoformine approaching the Seriema.
timeline.quote: A mass leech. Sometimes they just point you out for investigation. Sometimes they kill you.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Seriema falls toward Infinite Guideline at fifty kilometers a second.
timeline.quote: They are falling toward the Infinite Guideline , glittering all alone in the dark, at a handsome fifty kilometers a second.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya reluctantly aligns her Sunstar frequency-hopper so the Seriema can listen to Free Company traffic.
timeline.quote: It takes some verbal fencing before Haliya is willing to align her Sunstar Company frequency-hopper with the Seriema 's receiver.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The crew watches a distant space battle in which a ship is hit.
timeline.quote: Someone was hit, and died, or lived.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami sends a recorded message to Infinite Guideline offering information and requesting guidance.
timeline.quote: We are inbound. We offer gifts of information and request your guidance.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami declines to ask for mallowmass so that Infinite Guideline is not put at risk.
timeline.quote: We are under other protection.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami says their plan with Pinnacle is to tell the whole truth.
timeline.quote: So, I'm going to tell them the truth. All of it.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami reveals they were kitchen help on the Wurm Speaker, which went to the voices in the Wurmwall and mostly did not return.
timeline.quote: I was kitchen help. Not a lot of people came back.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Seriema reaches Infinite Guideline.
timeline.quote: They make it to Infinite Guideline .

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami meets Checkmate Mantis on the dock.
timeline.quote: "You must be Checkmate Mantis," Sami says

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami tells Mantis the whole story of the artifact unearthed at Sigma.
timeline.quote: I have come into possession of an artifact unearthed from the clay of Sigma.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mantis admits Vondam persuaded her lethal force might be justified but she has not used it.
timeline.quote: Checkmate Mantis draws a long, low drone from her legs. "Yes."

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The dock loses power and light as an unseen attack pierces it.
timeline.quote: The lights go out. The air pumps stop. The dock plunges into darkness.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sonar shows the dock has been holed in many places by tiny punctures.
timeline.quote: The dock has been holed in several places.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mantis identifies potential matter being pumped into the station.
timeline.quote: "Potential matter," Checkmate Mantis says.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A looping, topologically strange alien enters the dock through a hole.
timeline.quote: It is beautiful. It is a loop. It has no inside or outside.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mantis orders self-defense and the mechans shred the alien, which recovers.
timeline.quote: "Sanctioned self-defense!" Mantis orders, and the mechans open fire.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mantis's last war mechan carries Sami, Tannuk and Mantis up the docking arm away from an eld.
timeline.quote: The last surviving war mechan has seized all three of them and now boosts them up the spinal shaft of Infinite Guideline's number-three docking arm, away from the Seriema and the alien.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A second eld erupts into their path.
timeline.quote: Another alien erupts into their path.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mantis sacrifices her mechan to divert an eld and hurls Sami and Tannuk to an old ship hulk with a reactor.
timeline.quote: And before either of them can protest, the mechan hurls Sami and Tannuk at the ship hulk.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The eld has eaten Mantis's war mechan, which Sami sees as a graph of its components.
timeline.quote: It is a graph of the war mechan's components, spread in three dimensions. The thing has eaten it.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami opens a stasis cask and finds their lost cat Mirri.
timeline.quote: "Mirri?" Sami gasps.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami realizes Mirri weftwalked into a stasis cask on a similar ship and was frozen in time.
timeline.quote: She weftwalked away from the Seriema when she was startled and went to a ship that looked almost like the Seriema and landed in a stasis cask.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mirri yowls and weftwalks away from the approaching eld.
timeline.quote: Mirri yowls and vanishes. Weftwalks away.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami and Tannuk electrocute the eld by shorting a power cable down its mouth.
timeline.quote: A spectacular buzz. A flash of fire. Power arcs through the thing's matter.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Barrow's staff burns the eld attacking Tannuk and destroys it.
timeline.quote: The new flesh is burning .

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Drix introduces itself as Tumulus, or Barrow, a sentinel at the cofferdam.
timeline.quote: I am called Tumulus, or Barrow. I am a sentinel at the cofferdam.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tannuk calms Sami's panic and Sami decides what to do next.
timeline.quote: I can't decide what to do next. I need you to do it for me.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A Monoist gravkill paladin has taken the Seriema.
timeline.quote: The worshippers of INEVITA have taken the Seriema.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami stabs the Monoist armor in the chest.
timeline.quote: They stab the Monoist right in the chest.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The paladin says the Monoists will aid the Endstone if it goes through the eternity column.
timeline.quote: The Endstone has come here, to the eternity column. If it wishes to go through the eternity column, then it will, and we will aid it.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The gravkill paladin collapses into a crumpled ball of alabile, apparently killed by Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: The gravkill paladin collapses into a crumpled ball, like crushed foil.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami opens the stasis cask and Mirri trots out beside the Endstone.
timeline.quote: A cat trots out of the dark.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami learns the warp ferry is in a cherazad and the fleet will kill them as they prepare to warp.
timeline.quote: We can't leave the bubble! The Free Company fleet will kill us the moment we prepare to warp.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami jerks the Seriema free and drives at Infinite Guideline to force a game of chicken.
timeline.quote: With a drumbeat of thruster fire, they jerk the Seriema free of the mooring.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The eternity column opens, letting the Seriema into warp.
timeline.quote: Key meets lock. Eternity opens.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret toasts the success of taking a piece of the unknown.
timeline.quote: We have taken a piece of the unknown.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami realizes the Endstone is steering them toward the Wurmwall.
timeline.quote: They're headed toward the edge of Sothera—the Wurmwall.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret explains he sent the most disposable of his workers to Sigma so the stone could choose them.
timeline.quote: I chose the most desperate, disposable pawns in my employ.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tannuk recounts that he met Sami on the wreck of the Wurm Speaker after leaving Kavaron.
timeline.quote: That's where I met Captain Sami.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret says they are heading to the place that killed the Wurm Speaker.
timeline.quote: They are saying we are going to the place that killed it.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Seriema's engine dies and a silence falls over the ship.
timeline.quote: "The engine!" Tannuk says. "The engine's out!"

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A beautiful creature steps out of a split in the cosmos into the galley.
timeline.quote: A beautiful, beautiful creature steps through.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The visitor declares itself the last thing.
timeline.quote: "I am the last thing," the beautiful android says.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The visitor tells Sami the serpent needs a hero and to find it if they can.
timeline.quote: But the serpent needs a hero. Find me if you can.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret keeps the severed fingers, inhales their violet light and remarks that Sami has something like a Planeswalker.
timeline.quote: So. You do have something like a Planeswalker.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami holds Mirri, relieved that one thing is all right.
timeline.quote: Mirri is still here.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: After bad luck including Mirri's disappearance, Sami lost most of their crew to more lucrative outfits.
timeline.quote: After a run of bad luck (including the disappearance of their beloved cat, Mirri), they lost most of their crew to more lucrative outfits.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Exiled Tannuk joined Sami's crew and is now its last remaining member.
timeline.quote: Exiled from his people, Tannuk joined Sami and found the young captain to be as passionate about their crew as Tannuk was about his people.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tannuk's gut warned of danger but Sami pressed on regardless.
timeline.quote: Tannuk's gut warned of danger, but Sami forged ahead without heed.

citation.text: Sami's Curiosity (Edge of Eternities, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The story centers on the powerful artifact called the Endstone and features Tezzeret and new characters Sami, Tannuk, Alpharael and Haliya.
timeline.quote: The storyline centers on a powerful artifact called the Endstone

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As a favor to Tezzeret, Sami and Tannuk travel with the Seriema to Sigma's Reach and retrieve the Endstone.
timeline.quote: As a favor to Tezzeret, Sami and Tannuk traveled with the Seriema to Sigma's Reach to find the artifact.

citation.text: "Endstone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Endstone manipulates a fight between the Sunstar Free Company and Kavaron's defenders to help Sami, Tannuk and Alpharael escape.
timeline.quote: The Endstone manipulated a fight between the Sunstar Free Company and the defenders of Kavaron to help Sami, Tannuk, and Alpharael escape.

citation.text: "Endstone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haliya boards the Seriema and kills Sami and Tannuk before Alpharael sedates her; the Endstone revises the timeline so they were only knocked out.
timeline.quote: she killed Sami and Tannuk before Alpharael sedated her

citation.text: "Haliya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Wurm Speaker suffers a catastrophic event at the Wurmwall; most of the crew die and Tannuk helps Sami escape.
timeline.quote: After a catastrophic event, most of the crew were killed.

citation.text: "Sami", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sami buys the Seriema.
timeline.quote: Sami later bought a ship of their own, called the Seriema .

citation.text: "Sami", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mirri weftwalks off the ship and Sami's search costs them most of their crew, leaving Tannuk.
timeline.quote: only Tannuk staying on

citation.text: "Sami", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret contracts Sami and Tannuk to retrieve the Endstone from Sigma's Reach, where they find the colony vacant and the rock.
timeline.quote: they found the colony mysteriously vacant

citation.text: "Sami", section "Hunt for the Endstone". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sami and Tannuk save Alpharael after his ship crashes; Summists pursue, Haliya tries to steal the stone, and Sami and Tannuk flee Kavaron.
timeline.quote: allowing Sami and Tannuk to access the ship's controls and flee Kavaron

citation.text: "Sami", section "Hunt for the Endstone". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The crew takes the Endstone to Infinite Guideline Station, uses the station to warp enemies into the Wurmwall, and Sami recovers Mirri.
timeline.quote: they managed to use the station to warp them out into the Wurmwall

citation.text: "Sami", section "Hunt for the Endstone". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A Vaar android steps from a hole in space and reclaims the Endstone.
timeline.quote: a Vaar android stepped out to reclaim the Endstone

citation.text: "Sami", section "Hunt for the Endstone". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sami and Tannuk recover the Endstone for Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: Sami and Tannuk recovered the Endstone

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Edge of Eternities". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret hires Sami and Tannuk to investigate Sigma's Reach.
timeline.quote: he hired Sami and Tannuk to investigate

citation.text: "Mission for the Endstone", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sami and Tannuk find the colony deserted and discover the Endstone, which addresses Sami as a choosing one.
timeline.quote: which addressed Sami as a "choosing one" and caused visions of their corpse

citation.text: "Mission for the Endstone", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: They rescue Alpharael, who is pursued by the Sunstar Free Company.
timeline.quote: rescuing him after his Hopelight warmaker crashed in the debris field

citation.text: "Mission for the Endstone", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haliya infiltrates the Seriema to take the stone but fails.
timeline.quote: Sunstar squire Haliya infiltrated the Seriema to take the stone, but failed

citation.text: "Mission for the Endstone", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Seriema docks with Tezzeret's ship and the stone chooses Infinite Guideline Station.
timeline.quote: Chance indicated Infinite Guideline Station

citation.text: "Mission for the Endstone", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A battle at the station; Sami's group warps enemies into the Wurmwall and Sami recovers Mirri.
timeline.quote: Sami also recovered their missing cat Mirri from a stasis cask aboard the station

citation.text: "Mission for the Endstone", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tannuk met Captain Sami at the wreck of the Wurm Speaker and joined her crew.
timeline.quote: One day, they responded to the wreck of the Wurm Speaker , where he met captain Sami, and subsequently joined their crew.

citation.text: "Tannuk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sami and Tannuk found the Endstone at Sigma's Reach as a favor to Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: They found the Endstone and brought it back to their ship.

citation.text: "Tannuk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: They rescued Alpharael after his warmaker crashed.
timeline.quote: They managed to save the Monoist

citation.text: "Tannuk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haliya tried to take the Endstone from Alpharael; Sami and Tannuk fled Kavaron, and the Summists massacred Taro-duend.
timeline.quote: the Summists massacred the innocent civilians in Taro-duend to purge the influence of the Endstone

citation.text: "Tannuk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Sami's in their bunk on the Seriema .

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 2" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jun 2025.

relations.note: Tannuk serves as Sami's first mate.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

relations.note: The Free Company demands the escaped spies sheltering at Taro-duend.
relations.quote: They're demanding we turn over the escaped spies we're harboring.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

relations.quote: You could not ask for a better first mate or a worse fugitive than Tannuk.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

relations.note: Tannuk flies the escape beside Sami.
relations.quote: Sami just needs two quick hands, Tannuk at their side, and a hundred kilometers of altitude.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

relations.quote: I can't decide what to do next. I need you to do it for me.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

relations.quote: What flavor do you want, Sami?

pages_say.description: A human captain of the ship Seriema, who goes by they, searches for their lost cat Mirri and is hired to loot a ghost colony.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

pages_say.description: A human, going by they, captain of the Seriema, who explores the strange colony Sigma's Reach and finds an artifact stone.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 2" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jun 2025.

pages_say.description: A human scoundrel captain of the Seriema who is carrying a stolen artifact for the Metalman and cannot resist helping a stray, such as the crashed Hopelight pilot.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

pages_say.description: A human scoundrel captain of the Seriema who rescues irradiated Kav soldiers and investigates why the stolen stone seems tied to the empty mine at Sigma's Reach.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

pages_say.description: Captain of the Seriema who deduces that the stone makes them lucky, but is later shot by Haliya as they return to the ship.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

pages_say.description: Captain of the Seriema, who escapes Taro-duend using the Guns of Kavaron, takes Alpharael and Haliya in under mallowmass, and searches for a missing cat named Mirri.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

pages_say.description: Captain of the Seriema who devises a plan to steal a warp ferry from Infinite Guideline and wants to keep searching for their cat Mirri.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

pages_say.description: Captain of the Seriema who flies through a war zone to Infinite Guideline, tells Pinnacle the truth, and reveals they were kitchen help on the Wurm Speaker.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

pages_say.description: Captain of the Seriema who fights an eld with a power cable, is reunited with their lost cat Mirri, wins a game of chicken to open the eternity column, and is carried by the Endstone toward the Wurmwall.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

pages_say.description: A young nonbinary freelance captain of the Seriema who lost their cat Mirri and most of their crew, and seeks the score that will restore their fortunes.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.
